authority: Missouri Secretary of State and local election authorities
purpose: Missouri 2024 request tracker for source families that are not normalized into the current county/reporting-jurisdiction ETL package.

currentLoadedScope.results: Official county/reporting-jurisdiction President rows are loaded from the Missouri Secretary of State 2024 General Election results-by-county PDF.
currentLoadedScope.comparison: Official county/reporting-jurisdiction U.S. Senate rows are loaded from the same source PDF.
currentLoadedScope.turnout: Official Secretary of State registered-voter turnout rows are loaded at county/reporting-jurisdiction grain.
currentLoadedScope.historical: Official 2012, 2016, and 2020 presidential county/reporting-jurisdiction baseline rows are loaded from Missouri Secretary of State PDFs.
currentLoadedScope.map: Loaded geometry is Census county geometry only; Kansas City is a separate reporting jurisdiction in source data and does not have a separate Census county polygon.

requests.sourceAuthority: Missouri Secretary of State Elections Division
requests.sourceEvidence: The Missouri SOS results page states that precinct-level election results are available for general November elections from 1996 to 2024 and directs purchases/questions to the Elections Division.
neededArtifacts: 2024 general election precinct-level U.S. Senate rows
Candidate, party, contest, jurisdiction, precinct, and vote fields
Reporting-unit definitions needed to distinguish county jurisdictions, St. Louis City, and Kansas City
requests.requestPath: Contact the Missouri SOS Elections Division through the email link on the official results page.
requests.parserNeeded: precinctComparisonCsv or Missouri-specific precinct data parser after the file format is known.
requests.caveat: Do not describe Missouri review coverage as precinct-level until this file is obtained, parsed, reconciled, and paired with geometry or a reporting-unit crosswalk.

requests.sourceAuthority: Missouri Secretary of State and local election authorities
requests.sourceEvidence: The Missouri local election authority page distinguishes Jackson County outside Kansas City from Kansas City within Jackson County, matching the separate reporting-jurisdiction caveat in the result PDFs.
neededArtifacts: 2024 precinct boundary GIS or official reporting-unit geography
Precinct identifiers matching the purchasable precinct result file
Split-precinct definitions and county/Kansas City/St. Louis City crosswalk fields
requests.requestPath: Request statewide crosswalks from the Secretary of State if maintained; otherwise request jurisdiction-specific files from local election authorities.
requests.parserNeeded: precinctGeometryCrosswalkParser after source format is known.
requests.caveat: County map geometry remains valid for county joins only; no subcounty Missouri map overlay should be enabled from the current county geometry.

requests.sourceAuthority: Missouri Secretary of State and local election authorities
requests.sourceEvidence: The Missouri SOS election-security page states that Missouri has 116 election jurisdictions, each with its own voting system, and that election results are audited by local election officials before certification.
neededArtifacts: Machine totals, hand totals, discrepancies, explanations, and final outcomes
requests.requestPath: Collect public statewide audit summaries if published; otherwise request certificates and outcome records from the Secretary of State or each local election authority.
requests.caveat: The current inventory documents the source path only; no 2024 Missouri audit selection or outcome rows are loaded.

requests.sourceAuthority: Missouri Secretary of State and local election authorities
requests.sourceEvidence: Local election authorities are the practical public-records path for county-specific ballot-system records, while the current inventory keeps CVR availability separate from the purchasable precinct result file.
neededArtifacts: County-by-county CVR existence and releasability status
Custodian, request path, format, redaction limits, and ballot-mode fields
Any public CVR export or denial/availability response
requests.requestPath: Request or confirm CVR availability with local election authorities and the Secretary of State as applicable.
requests.parserNeeded: cvrAvailabilityInventoryCsv after county responses are collected.
requests.caveat: No Missouri CVR dataset or county CVR availability table is loaded.

requests.sourceAuthority: Missouri Secretary of State, courts, and local election authorities
requests.sourceEvidence: The Missouri SOS Elections Integrity page identifies complaint paths and HAVA determinations; the SOS results page is the official recount-results location checked for 2024 general-election links.
neededArtifacts: Official 2024 amended canvasses or correction notices
Complaint or HAVA determinations relevant to election administration
Court dockets, orders, and local incident reports where public
requests.requestPath: Inventory published SOS/court/local records first, then request missing records from the relevant custodian.
requests.parserNeeded: administrationEventInventoryCsv after source records are collected.
requests.caveat: No normalized Missouri incident, correction, recount, or litigation rows are loaded.

requests.sourceEvidence: The local election authority page separates Jackson County outside Kansas City from Kansas City within Jackson County.
neededArtifacts: Keep Kansas City as a reporting-jurisdiction caveat in review, turnout, and map displays
Do not expect a separate Kansas City polygon from Census county geometry
requests.requestPath: No new request is required for current county-level display; a precinct/crosswalk request is required before subcounty display.
requests.caveat: Kansas City source rows should be treated as a separate reporting jurisdiction, not a separate county geometry feature.

validationExpectations: Missouri staging should continue to emit 116 result rows, 116 review rows, 116 turnout rows, and 348 historical baseline rows before any production promotion.
native:report-indicators must be rerun on regenerated staging before promotion; advisory indicators are review signals only, not findings.
Any future precinct upgrade must reconcile precinct President totals to certified county/reporting-jurisdiction totals and document Kansas City/St. Louis City handling.
